segments.ja453:1.1: Kiṃsu naro jappamadhiccakāle, kaṃ vā vijjaṃ katamaṃ vā sutānaṃ;
segments.ja453:1.3: So macco asmiñca [asmiṃva (pī.)] paramhi loke, kathaṃ karo sotthānena gutto.
segments.ja453:2.1: Yassa devā pitaro ca sabbe, sarīsapā [siriṃsapā (sī. syā. pī.)] sabbabhūtāni cāpi;
segments.ja453:2.3: Mettāya niccaṃ apacitāni honti, bhūtesu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:4.1: Yo nāvajānāti sahāyamitte [sahāyamatte (sī. pī.)], sippena kulyāhi dhanena jaccā;
segments.ja453:4.3: Rucipañño atthakāle matīmā [mutīmā (sī. pī.)], sahāyesu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:5.1: Mittāni ve yassa bhavanti santo, saṃvissatthā avisaṃvādakassa;
segments.ja453:5.3: Na mittadubbhī saṃvibhāgī dhanena, mittesu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:6.1: Yassa bhariyā tulyavayā samaggā, anubbatā dhammakāmā pajātā [sajātā (ka.)];
segments.ja453:6.3: Koliniyā sīlavatī patibbatā, dāresu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:7.1: Yassa rājā bhūtapati [bhūtapatī (sī. syā. pī.)] yasassī, jānāti soceyyaṃ parakkamañca;
segments.ja453:7.3: Advejjhatā suhadayaṃ mamanti, rājūsu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:8.1: Annañca pānañca dadāti saddho, mālañca gandhañca vilepanañca;
segments.ja453:8.3: Pasannacitto anumodamāno, saggesu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:9.1: Yamariyadhammena punanti vuddhā, ārādhitā samacariyāya santo;
segments.ja453:9.3: Bahussutā isayo sīlavanto, arahantamajjhe sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
segments.ja453:10.1: Etāni kho sotthānāni loke, viññuppasatthāni sukhudrayāni [sukhindriyāni (pī.)];
segments.ja453:10.3: Tānīdha sevetha naro sapañño, na hi maṅgale kiñcanamatthi saccanti.
